changed: Lines like “Women walk forward to N2” and “Men walk forward; form wave of four with shadow” now read as a pass through, with who walks kept in the figure's note, instead of as plain text. This covers importing from The Caller's Box and typing a line in the dance editor, where you then choose who passes as for any new pass. A line with words between “walk forward” and where it goes, such as “on side”, stays as text.

A walk-forward pass through that names its subject (`Women walk forward to N2`, `… walk forward; form wave of four with <dancer>`) structures as `pass_through` with `who` unstated and the subject, in the source's words, leading its note (`role2s to n2`, `role2s walk forward`), in both the shared figure parser and The Caller's Box front end.
